verdict.rationale: Foreloop runs fixed, built-in automations in the background: connected repositories get automatic product reviews on pull requests, re-run on push. Incoming feedback also triggers an agent that reads the submission, fills in the intention and proposes tasks. Running the CLI from cron is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: user-configurable automation definitions or triggers, native recurring schedules, documented background/unattended run controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Connect a repository and get automatic product reviews on your pull requests.
An intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
Push changes or have a repository writer comment @foreloop retest. Results appear on Home and on GitHub.
